description: REQUIRED_COLUMNS asserts exact-string equality on information_schema.columns.data_type/udt_name (e.g. 'double precision', 'jsonb', 'timestamp with time zone', 'ARRAY'/'_text'). These are stable across supported Postgres major versions so real-world risk is low, but the comparison is brittle-by-construction (case/display-name drift would silently flip S3.2 to FAIL with a confusing diff rather than a normalized/tolerant comparison). Flagged for completeness, not blocking on its own.
